## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; mixed signals — broad sector participation but Tech and Financials weak on 1W, and leadership split between cyclicals and select Tech, supporting a neutral read with no strong directional bias.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: DD ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +18.65%) and broad materials strength. Industrials lead: CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), DE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.01% | 1M: +24.85%). Communication strength via CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +16.64%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: sector 1W -0.24% with heavyweight MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -15.26%) and mixed leaders. Financials lagging: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -4.21%) and SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%). Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%) and GM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -3.72%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AVGO RECOVERY (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.68%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%). Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Industrials/Materials prominence.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TMO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -14.34%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%), GM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -3.72%), ADBE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.06% | 1M: -21.51%), SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%). Weakness concentrated across Tech and parts of Healthcare/Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.21%), CAT (1W: +12.02%), AVGO (1W: +11.27%), NVDA (1W: +9.11%), EQIX (1W: +8.15%) — all showing short-term momentum. Major divergence flagged: AVGO RECOVERY (1W up | 1M down), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -23.22%), TSLA RECOVERY (1W: +5.48% | 1M: -4.61%) — tactical setups, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-rotational: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) and AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%) drive pockets of strength while MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -15.26%) and CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%) keep sector tone uneven; sector 1W: -0.24% (19 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft and selective: Large names lag with JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -4.21%) and SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -6.33%), leaving Financials 1W: -1.03% (20 stocks) and limiting a clear risk-on rotation via banks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive bid present in parts: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.73% | 1M: +14.85%) and PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +11.57%) offset pressure on names like LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -8.30% | 1M: -6.09%); sector 1W: +1.07% (15 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to cyclicals and select materials/industrials (CAT ABOVE TREND, DD ABOVE TREND, DE ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to extended/software names showing sustained downside (CRM BELOW TREND, ADBE BELOW TREND, INTU BELOW TREND); style: Value/Cyclical tilt but remain selective given mixed Tech leadership and recovery signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%).  
BEARISH: AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -12.41% | 1M: -17.20%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -28.68%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -37.10%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +3.10% | 13 stocks), Materials (1W: +4.50% | 7 stocks) — watch continuation in cyclical names.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.24% | 19 stocks) and Financials (1W: -1.03% | 20 stocks) — watch for further dispersion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA: sustain above this week's breakout high to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AMAT: hold recent 1W gains for further upside continuation; ORCL: watch failure above this week's pop as a sign of distribution given 1M deterioration; CAT: follow-through above recent highs to validate cyclical leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PFE (+60): PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +11.57%) — news (share returns) confirms price strength.  
EQIX (+50): EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%) — AI-driven growth headlines align with price, though watch mixed follow-ups.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ORCL (-55): ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +7.15% | 1M: -23.22%) — negative legal headlines diverge from recent bounce, watch for distribution.  
AMAT (-50): AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%) — regulatory/legal headline is bearish versus strong price action, flag for diligence.  
EQIX (-55): EQIX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.15% | 1M: +10.67%) — mixed/contradictory news flows; monitor follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Industrials/Materials leadership and broad 8/11 sector participation. CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +23.35%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.21% | 1M: +10.62%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.11% | 1M: +2.76%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: Major recovery divergences (ORCL RECOVERY, AVGO RECOVERY, TSLA RECOVERY) and mixed news flow on EQIX/AMAT — monitor for trend breaks.
